invalidated_reason: Canonical config/path equality and an exclusive one-shot attempt lock were absent. The generation is permanently closed and must not produce a candidate.
purpose: Correct the denominator, masking, and forward-validation defects identified in the 2026-08-22 P2 validation-system audit without opening a new hyperparameter search.

candidate.lean_arm: existing public-temperature 6h and M2 dynamics residual LightGBM
candidate.postprocess: existing label-blind layer-1/layer-5 envelope clip plus three-layer unit-weight isotonic projection

masking.scope: all timestamps used for feature construction
masking.labels: target temperature is retained in a separate in-memory label population and never reintroduced into feature context

validation.inner_role: training-side diagnostic only; it selects no epoch, feature, weight, factor, threshold, or postprocess
validation.primary_metric: sqrt(mean over outer folds of official-layer-weighted MSE)

preflight_amendment.reason: Exact official-like eligibility includes finite public interpolation support in addition to finite target temperature. The initial 0.975 raw-target assumption rejected otherwise full 61/62-day windows at 0.9714 and 0.9634 coverage. A fixed 0.96 floor retains natural gaps while still excluding the materially truncated 0.87, 0.69, 0.15, and 0.64 windows.

excluded_primary_windows.2024_may_jun: official-like eligible target coverage below the fixed 0.96 floor

final_training.population: all finite legally distributed target temperatures outside the hidden null window with finite public-layer interpolation support
final_training.interpretation: legal offline full-train reconstruction; forward OOF remains a conservative research diagnostic and is not an absolute hidden calibration
